pages.title: Load the Charge
pages.text: Load three Raw Copper, a reusable fired Casting Mold, and furnace fuel. Ignite explicitly. Fuel burns continuously using its Minecraft furnace duration, including between recipes. The unassisted ceiling is 800°C: too cool for copper casting.

pages.title: Cast with Air
pages.text: Bellows raise the ceiling to 1150°C, but heat rises gradually. Copper casting requires 1085°C and 240 ticks at or above that temperature. Below the requirement, progress pauses without being erased. Completing a recipe does not extinguish the fire.

pages.title: Air Loss
pages.text: A blow holds the boosted ceiling for eight seconds, then it falls over four seconds toward 800°C. Current temperature drops with that ceiling. Blow again to maintain casting heat; boosts refresh rather than stack. Jade shows current/max temperature and the recipe requirement.

pages.title: Loading Roles
pages.text: Empty-hand use collects output; sneak-empty-hand use retrieves stored material. Normal insertion favours input and catalyst. Sneak-use a valid fuel to force the fuel role when a pack also uses that item as a recipe ingredient.
